answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the trellis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the voyage of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the velvet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
